verdict.rationale: Viam's official CLI documents filter-based bulk operations: deleting data, and adding or removing tags on all data matching a filter. It also documents export and SQL/MQL queries over data. Fleet-level OTA updates and fragments imply configuration applied across many machines, and the CLI's JSON-in/JSON-out design suits agent-driven automation. Missing for 10: explicit docs on bulk machine or config operations (fragments are named but not described as bulk), bulk command execution across many machines, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
